newsitem.title: UK: B&W votes for merger with Bank of Ireland.
newsitem.headline: B&W votes for merger with Bank of Ireland.

text.p: Bristol & West Building Society said on Tuesday that its investing and borrowing members had voted "overwhelmingly" in favour ot its merger with the Bank of Ireland group.
Bank of Ireland agreed last year to acquire Bristol & West for 600 million stg, in what was described as the biggest strategic move in its 213-year history.
The vote means more than one million members of the Bristol & West will receive either cash or shares. Long-standing members will be rewarded with an average of 1,100 stg in cash.
Bristol & West was Britain's ninth largest building society, a mutually owned home loan and savings institution with its headquarters in the south-western city of Bristol.

Bank of Ireland stockholders are scheduled to consider the proposals at an Extraordinary General Court on April 23. Subject to their approval and that of the relevant regulatory authorities, the merger will become effective on July 28.
